name: 1 Peter
section: New Testament: General Letters and Revelation
author: The apostle Peter.
setting: Written to scattered believers facing hostility.
theme: Christians live as exiles with a living hope.

outline.label: A living hope and a holy people
Born again to a living hope
A chosen race and a royal priesthood
Submission and the example of Christ

christInBook: Peter says that Christ suffered for us, leaving us an example (2:21), bore our sins in his body on the tree (2:24), and that we are redeemed with the precious blood of Christ, like that of a lamb without blemish (1:18-19).
howToRead: 1 Peter is addressed to suffering Christians. Notice how he links suffering and glory, and how he calls the church “exiles” and “a holy priesthood.”
